invariant: NoEvictionDuringActiveDrain: A model undergoing drain or unload due to active executions cannot transition to unloaded while active executions remain in-flight, and if unload aborts with MODEL_IN_USE, its healthy READY state must be restored
preconditions: A model is in READY state; unload(modelId, { drain: true, timeoutMs: ... }) is called while active execution is in-flight and fails to drain before timeout, or active executions are detected at the assignment barrier
sequence: 1. unload() transitions instance state to DRAINING (or UNLOADING); 2. In-flight active executions do not finish within drain timeout or are detected at barrier; 3. unload() throws ModelLifecycleError('MODEL_IN_USE'); 4. Catch block re-throws without resetting state; 5. Model remains trapped permanently in DRAINING/UNLOADING, breaking isModelReady() and causing future admissions to reject with RESOURCE_BUSY
alloy_verdict: COUNTEREXAMPLE on mutant (SAT) / VERIFIED on hardened (UNSAT)
expected: Model state is restored to previousState ('READY') and isModelReady(modelId) returns true
observed: Model state remained stuck in 'DRAINING' or 'UNLOADING', causing isModelReady(modelId) to return false
patch: Capture previousState before unload; in catch block, restore instance state to previousState ?? 'READY' when error is MODEL_IN_USE
post_fix_evidence: Vitest modelLifecycleAdmission.test.ts passes (29/29); restores READY state tests pass; 80/80 total core admission/resource tests pass
limitations: Applies to abortable drain timeouts and active execution barriers; hardware or driver-level unloads that crash host process require external heartbeat recovery

invariant: NoDoubleReservationRelease: A resource reservation cannot be concurrently active and released, nor released more than once

Downstream telemetry/quota listeners process duplicate release events, corrupting reservation tracking and metrics
expected: Exactly 1 RESOURCE_RESERVATION_RELEASED event is emitted per unloaded reservation
observed: 2 duplicate RESOURCE_RESERVATION_RELEASED events were emitted per unloaded reservation
patch: Removed duplicate emitEvent call in unload() since computer.finishReservation is the authoritative event source
post_fix_evidence: Vitest modelLifecycleAdmission.test.ts passes (29/29); exactly one release event test passes; 80/80 total core admission/resource tests pass
limitations: Multi-node cluster requires distributed event deduplication if network retransmits occur

In-memory registry still has pinned = false during store write; 5. Concurrent planEviction or evict() inspects in-memory instance, sees pinned = false, and selects pinned model for eviction

patch: Synchronously update registry.upsertInstance({ ...current, pinned: true/false }) in pin(), unpin(), and persistIntent before awaiting store.put

invariant: NoDoubleReservationRelease: A reservation that has been settled must not be double-released or re-settled on post-readiness failure
preconditions: performLoad() successfully loads adapter and settles reservation, but subsequent step (refreshResources or persistReadyModelSet) fails
sequence: 1. Adapter finishes loadModel; 2. finishReservation(reservation.id, false) marks reservation settled; 3. deps.refreshResources or persistReadyModelSet throws error; 4. Catch block catches error and calls finishReservation(reservation.id, !confirmedLoaded); 5. Already-settled reservation is re-finished as released or causes accounting invariant failure
